findings.action: click the sign-in button and assert redirect to /auth/callback
findings.title: OAuth redirect lands on localhost instead of /auth/callback
locale_snapshot: By continuing you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy
Already have an account? Sign in
findings.judgment: After clicking the Google sign-in button, the OAuth redirect target is localhost:3000 rather than the production callback URL. Users on production will land on an error page after authenticating.

findings.action: navigate to /dashboard and assert page title
findings.title: Dashboard loads with correct title
findings.judgment: Dashboard rendered correctly. Title and welcome copy match expected strings. No console errors or network failures observed.

findings.action: click Create Session button and assert modal opens
findings.title: Create session modal opens on button click
findings.judgment: Clicking Create Session opened the modal with correct copy. All form fields are present and labeled. No accessibility violations.

findings.action: reveal scores and assert score chips are distinct
findings.title: Duplicate chip DOM id causes wrong chip to highlight on reveal
axe_top3: duplicate-id: All id attribute values must be unique
color-contrast: Elements must have sufficient color contrast
label: Form elements must have labels
findings.judgment: Score chips are rendered but two chips share the same DOM id. Axe-core flags this as a WCAG violation. The highlight animation applies to the first element with that id, causing the wrong chip to animate on reveal.

findings.action: assert post-auth redirect lands on /dashboard with user greeting
findings.title: ReferenceError thrown after auth; dashboard does not render
findings.judgment: After the auth redirect, a ReferenceError fires in the client bundle. The dashboard component fails to mount. The user sees a blank page. This is a blocking regression.

top3: duplicate-id: All id attribute values must be unique
color-contrast: Elements must have sufficient color contrast
label: Form elements must have labels
